Your eleven projects 60.8 points. The armband on Haaland—who is 0.3 clear of Salah—takes that to 69.0, though he carries some downside risk: an 8% tail of two points or fewer. The structure is balanced at 3-4-3, with three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City.

The recommended move is Wood out for Watkins, gaining 6.4 points with no hit cost. Watkins's projection is stronger over the horizon, and you have the free transfer to make it. Wood's bench replacement would be Mykolenko at 3.1, the best of what's available to you.

One note: Muniz is flagged as doubtful with a 50% chance of playing. He sits fourth on the bench behind Anderson, so unless injuries force a change, he is unlikely to affect your gameweek. If your other forwards all play, he will not come on.

Make the Wood-to-Watkins swap and you are set.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland captained. The eleven is strong across the board, with Salah and Haaland both well-placed and your three Arsenal players offering coverage of a reliable defence.

The model recommends Wood to Watkins. Watkins gains 6.4 points over the horizon with no hit cost. This is your free transfer and leaves you £0.5m in the bank. The move addresses Wood's modest 4.2 projection without sacrificing depth — Mykolenko and Anderson remain on the bench at 3.1 and 2.9 respectively.

Muniz on the bench is flagged as 50% doubtful. Since he does not start, this carries no immediate risk to your XI, though it does reduce the quality of your emergency cover.

Haaland holds the armband by 0.3 over Salah. Haaland carries an 8% tail risk of scoring 2 or fewer, against a 25% ceiling above 10. The gap is tight enough that either choice is defensible, but the model prefers him.

Your eleven projects 60.8 points with Haaland captained. He sits 0.3 clear of Salah and carries a 25% chance of hitting double figures, though he also runs an 8% risk of returning 2 or fewer. The armband looks safe enough on current information.

The transfer from Wood to Watkins nets 6.4 points across the horizon with no points hit attached. Watkins enters a three-man Chelsea midfield already built around Palmer and Saka, so you are concentrating attacking talent there rather than spreading it.

Muniz on the bench is flagged doubtful at 50% chance of playing. If he fails to start and you have no fit outfield cover to bring in from the bench, you would field ten men in that position. Pope and Mykolenko are your only bench alternatives, neither of which solves a forward dropout.

No free transfers remain after this move. The bank sits at £0.5m.
